manifestations.description: mild right-sided headache, intermittent, once to twice per day
left shoulder pain, dull ache, intermittent, worse at night or on elevation
neck pain, dull ache, intermittent, sometimes on movement of the neck or when he had 'influenza'
right sided neck pain radiating to right shoulder
pain over the back between the shoulder blades / bilateral scapular stiffness in the morning and tender on pressure
morning stiffness of upper part of the body, lasting for 3-4 hours
post concussion syndrome including headaches and dizziness, sometimes requiring painkillers
feeling of distress and difficulty in temper control
significant pain associated with mild bruised swelling at the left antero-lateral aspect of the neck

treatments_received: transferred to the Accident and Emergency Department of the Tuen Mun Hospital and then to the neurosurgical ward on 16th April, 1994
transferred to the orthopaedic ward for further management
placed in a Halo ring with body jacket on 20th April, 1994
admitted on 4th July, 1994 for removal of the Halo ring and body jacket
X-ray examination showed that the fracture was healded
discharged on 8th July, 1994 and thereafter received follow up and outpatient physiotherapy treatment

losses.description: fracture of the cervical spine with continuing pain and stiffness
considerable stiffness of the neck and reduced movement
feeling of distress and difficulty in temper control
unable to return to pre-accident occupation as an interior decorator
